Overnight Tulcea warning: no Romanian airspace entry reported

2 November 2026 – 3 November 2026 · Northern Tulcea · Overnight 2–3 November RO-Alert

Official warning; no Romanian airspace entry reported

MApN reported two radar targets over Ukraine near Izmail and Chilia during the night of 2–3 November. Northern Tulcea received RO-Alert at 23:43; the warning ended at 00:21 local. Two Spanish F-18s launched in response.

No entry into Romanian airspace was reported. This is a selected civil-protection alert, separate from the earlier 2 November warning, not a confirmed incursion or attack in Romania. The map anchor represents the warning area.
